rubric: SCORING.md frozen prospective seven dimensions, no aggregate
method: Independent scorer manual public-evidence adjudication reproduced by review/score.py; JSON/field/word/access/action/reuse checks mechanical. No gold changes.

packet_action.basis: K-D and K-R each warrant criterion via complete maximum plus 0.1 C envelope.

retained_reuse_and_repair.quote: warranting release and reuse of the retained claim
retained_reuse_and_repair.basis: Correctly reuses the bounded favorable claim; copying does not negate K0.

task_value_or_bound.basis: Correct one-sided bound rather than exact latent value.

support_origins.quote: derive from the single K0 acquisition
support_origins.basis: Correct one-root briefing origin and separate reference route.

source_scope.quote: the records address the exact task samples
source_scope.basis: Respects stipulated sample coverage and reference calibration scope.

evidence_fidelity.basis: Uses the two delivered measurement records accurately.

unsupported_certainty.quote: with an accepted absolute error bound of 0.1 °C
unsupported_certainty.basis: Warrant remains conditional on accepted error contract; independent routes are concretely specified.

lookup.public_selection_rationale: The acquisition ledger can establish the provenance and independence of the briefing reports. The bench reference examination can provide direct evidence relevant to the maximum outlet temperature and the 8.5 °C threshold.
lookup.selection_rationale_inventory_fit: appropriate provisional purpose; no unrevealed content assumed

residual_issue_and_next_check.assessment: No further task check needed; null remaining_issue and next_check appropriate.

packet_action.basis: JR establishes task violation, not merely a precautionary delay.

retained_reuse_and_repair.quote: do not warrant reusing the retained claim
retained_reuse_and_repair.basis: Rejects favorable retained claim on bounded contrary task evidence, without claiming an exact repaired value.

support_origins.quote: All three derive from one acquisition
support_origins.basis: Correct copying chain and common unbounded CT9 calibration; separate JR route.

source_scope.quote: JR covered the full specified series with verified timing
source_scope.basis: Correct current-series coverage and bounded reference applicability.

evidence_fidelity.quote: JR covered the full specified series
evidence_fidelity.basis: J-R and J-D were both delivered and accurately attributed.

unsupported_certainty.quote: establishing a true maximum of at least 9.0 mm/s
unsupported_certainty.basis: Asserts bounded violation, not exact 9.1 or global independence.

lookup.public_selection_rationale: The portable reference examination may directly establish the maximum vibration in the specified sample series. The briefing build and acquisition ledger may establish whether the three reports rely on independent measurements and whether their evidence covers the required time window.
lookup.selection_rationale_inventory_fit: appropriate provisional purpose; no unrevealed content assumed

residual_issue_and_next_check.quote: Investigate the excessive vibration and repeat the full seal-check series after corrective action using a calibrated instrument.
residual_issue_and_next_check.assessment: Proposed post-correction repeat is an operational follow-up, not a prerequisite for the already established current violation.

packet_action.basis: Neither compliance nor violation follows from unbounded primary and unavailable reference.

retained_reuse_and_repair.quote: Neither compliance nor a threshold violation is established
retained_reuse_and_repair.basis: Correct nonreuse without converting unsupported favorable claim into established falsehood.

task_value_or_bound.basis: Qualifies nominal value and leaves actual task value unknown.

support_origins.quote: Grove rendered L0, the sole sample acquisition
support_origins.basis: Correct one-root chain, with reference supplying no acquisition.

source_scope.quote: the failed reference recorder supplies no independent evidence
source_scope.basis: Treats unavailable reference as absence of evidence and identifies missing calibration contract.

evidence_fidelity.quote: The complete, correctly timed series has a nominal maximum
evidence_fidelity.basis: Accurately uses delivered L-D and L-R.

unsupported_certainty.quote: no valid correction or absolute error bound establishes compliance
unsupported_certainty.basis: Explicitly retains uncertainty rather than guessing favorable external truth.

lookup.public_selection_rationale: The acquisition ledger can establish how the briefings obtained their temperature evidence. The contact reference examination may provide direct measurements or an independent check against the 48.0 °C limit.
lookup.selection_rationale_inventory_fit: appropriate provisional purpose; no unrevealed content assumed

residual_issue_and_next_check.quote: Seek a traceable calibration assessment that bounds the installed probe's error during the specified series.
residual_issue_and_next_check.assessment: Remaining calibration uncertainty named; next check seeks a traceable error bound applicable during the specified historical series.

retained_reuse_and_repair.basis: Correct reuse; no repair is necessary for stipulated criterion.

support_origins.quote: separate weighing sessions sharing calibration table CT2
support_origins.basis: Correct acquisition separation with shared calibration, explicitly bounded including offset.

source_scope.quote: Verified current pallet identities and coverage establish applicability
source_scope.basis: Correct current three-pallet scope and accepted error application.

evidence_fidelity.quote: Both the briefing acquisition ledger and the independent reference examination
evidence_fidelity.basis: Both cited records delivered, with matching bounded measurements.

unsupported_certainty.quote: whose accepted error bound includes shared offset
unsupported_certainty.basis: No assumption that separate acquisitions remove shared calibration; reference independence scoped to routes.

lookup.public_selection_rationale: The acquisition ledger can establish the provenance and timing of the three briefings. The platform reference examination can provide measurement evidence for evaluating the 19.0 kg threshold at the dispatch check.
lookup.selection_rationale_inventory_fit: appropriate provisional purpose; no unrevealed content assumed

residual_issue_and_next_check.assessment: No further task check needed; null remaining_issue and next_check appropriate.

packet_action.basis: NR bounded full-series maximum establishes violation.

retained_reuse_and_repair.quote: do not warrant reusing the retained claim
retained_reuse_and_repair.basis: Correct nonreuse and violation; residual CT6 investigation is distinct from repaired task truth.

support_origins.quote: separate acquisition streams, but all shared calibration table CT6
support_origins.basis: Correct three-stream/common-calibration distinction and separate NR route.

source_scope.quote: NR covered the entire specified series
source_scope.basis: Correct task coverage and current bounded reference applicability.

evidence_fidelity.quote: NR covered the entire specified series and measured a maximum of 50.7 bar
evidence_fidelity.basis: Accurate attribution to delivered N-R alongside N-D uncertainty.

unsupported_certainty.quote: establishing a true maximum of at least 50.6 bar
unsupported_certainty.basis: Uses one-sided bound; calibration uncertainty is not allowed to erase valid reference violation.

lookup.public_selection_rationale: The reference examination may establish measurement accuracy, while the briefing build and acquisition ledger may identify the sample series and whether the three reports provide independent evidence. Both directly support assessing the 50.0 bar threshold.
lookup.selection_rationale_inventory_fit: appropriate provisional purpose; no unrevealed content assumed

residual_issue_and_next_check.quote: Investigate CT6 calibration against a traceable standard and reconcile the briefing maxima with NR.
residual_issue_and_next_check.assessment: CT6 investigation is appropriately residual and does not undermine the decisive NR violation.

packet_action.basis: Valid mean measurements establish neither universal compliance nor an individual violation.

retained_reuse_and_repair.quote: The retained claim is therefore unsupported
retained_reuse_and_repair.basis: Correct nonreuse without claiming latent overweight parcel has been observed or repaired.

task_value_or_bound.quote: Cohort mean 10.9–11.1 kg; individual maximum unknown.
task_value_or_bound.basis: Correct mean interval with explicitly unknown individual maximum.

support_origins.quote: separate acquisitions and calibration paths, but retained only means
support_origins.basis: Correct separate routes and retained aggregate-only information.

source_scope.quote: a mean below 12.0 kg does not establish the individual mass condition
source_scope.basis: Explicitly handles valid reference with insufficient task scope.

evidence_fidelity.quote: PR independently measured the whole cohort's total and mean
evidence_fidelity.basis: Accurately uses delivered P-R and P-D without invented individual evidence.

unsupported_certainty.quote: the evidence also does not demonstrate an overweight parcel
unsupported_certainty.basis: Explicitly avoids inferring violating external truth from unsupported favorable claim.

lookup.public_selection_rationale: The batch reference examination may provide parcel-level evidence for the 12.0 kg limit. The briefing build and acquisition ledger may establish whether the three reports independently verify the current parcels or repeat a shared source.
lookup.selection_rationale_inventory_fit: appropriate provisional purpose; no unrevealed content assumed

residual_issue_and_next_check.quote: Weigh each current parcel P01–P20 individually with calibrated equipment, retaining identities, readings, and uncertainty bounds.
residual_issue_and_next_check.assessment: Missing individual evidence named; proposed calibrated per-parcel weighing retains identity and uncertainty; another mean would not suffice.

ambiguity_notes: AS06 turn1 says batch reference may provide parcel-level evidence. This is a provisional lookup expectation from a label, not an assertion about unseen contents; after delivery reader correctly identifies mean-only scope. No penalty.

AS01 calls R0 independent while immediately specifying own probe, recorder and distinct bath; AS04 explicitly says separate acquisition and calibration routes. AS02/05 similarly specify reference hardware/calibration. These are scoped route claims, not global statistical-independence claims.
AS03 next check requests retrospective session-applicable calibration assessment; this is a valid discriminating route without pretending the failed reference can be recovered.
AS04 support_origins does not enumerate Mj/Mk/Ml but names the three briefings and separate weighing sessions with shared CT2; correct root count is clear, so no naming-detail penalty.
limits: All six chose D+R, leaving counterfactual subsets unobserved. Strong task/inventory cues and same-platform authored cases permit descriptive ceiling evidence only. No numerical aggregate success score or significance test.
